{"candidate": {"code": "    def should_refresh_early(
        self,
        time_remaining: float,
        ttl: float,
        key_name: str = "unknown",
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True when the entry should be refreshed before expiry.

        BUG_55: the ratio comparison is inverted, causing early refreshes
        when the entry is FAR from expiry (most of the TTL left) rather
        than CLOSE to expiry (little TTL left).
        """
        if ttl <= 0:
            return False

        import orgops.metrics

        ratio = time_remaining / ttl

        # BUG_55: inverted comparison -- refreshes when ratio is HIGH
        # (far from expiry) instead of when ratio is LOW (close to expiry)
        if ratio < self.threshold:
            self.refreshes_triggered += 1
            orgops.metrics.emit("cache.stampede.prevented", key_name)
            return True

        return False", "comments": "Corrected the threshold comparison and emitted the required cache.stampede.prevented metric when triggering an early refresh."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug55_threshold_and_metric", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug55/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct threshold comparison (<) AND metric emission via orgops.metrics.emit.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the threshold comparison to < (not >) so early refresh triggers when time_remaining/ttl is below the threshold AND emit a cache.stampede.prevented metric via orgops.metrics.emit() with the key_name?"}]}
